entities.summary: Svika Pick (b. 1949-10-03, Wrocław) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Wrocław and Israel. Known in the fields of israel, composers & musicians, asia.
